summary: The blueprint broadly covers human pancreas cell classes but needs targeted refinement for quiescent stellate cells, cytotoxic T cells, and several vascular/neural/myeloid marker choices.

issues.description: Healthy human pancreas commonly contains quiescent pancreatic stellate cells, which are not cleanly represented; current stromal markers emphasize generic ECM fibroblast/activated matrix, while quiescent stellate/lipid-storage markers are split across pericyte and adipocyte modules.
issues.suggested_fix: Add or refocus a quiescent pancreatic stellate module/axis with markers such as RGS5, ADIRF, GPX3, IGFBP4, FABP4, C11orf96, and CSRP2, while retaining matrix_remodeling_within_stellate_fibroblast for activated/remodeling state.

issues.description: TFF3 is an epithelial/secretory marker and is out of place in a lymphatic endothelial module.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace TFF3 with a canonical lymphatic endothelial marker such as RELN, FOXC2, or NRP2.

issues.description: SELE and ICAM1 are endothelial activation/inflammation markers rather than stable baseline venous/capillary identity markers, making the subtype axis partly state-driven in a healthy/null-condition scenario.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace SELE and ICAM1 with more stable capillary/venous endothelial markers such as CA4, EDNRB, APLNR, ENG, or GNG11.

issues.description: The blueprint separates T cells and NK cells but does not explicitly capture cytotoxic T cells; cytotoxic genes are concentrated in nk_cell while t_cell is biased toward general/naive-like T markers.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a cytotoxic_t_cell gated axis under T cells using markers such as CD8A, CD8B, GZMK, GZMA, CCL5, NKG7, and/or TRAC, contrasted against NK markers where appropriate.

issues.description: The neuron axis is gated by a glial/Schwann module, so true neuronal cells may score weakly if they do not coexpress enough glial markers; neural_glial also includes NRXN1, which is more neuronal than glial.
issues.suggested_fix: Either make neuron a plain axis alongside a cleaned Schwann/glial axis, or add a broader neural gate that contains both Schwann/glial and neuronal markers before applying the neuron refinement.

issues.description: myeloid_core is somewhat macrophage-skewed because of C1QA, C1QB, and C1QC, and dendritic_cell collapses cDC1, cDC2, and pDC markers into one module.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the core myeloid gate less macrophage-specific by emphasizing shared markers such as LYZ, AIF1, TYROBP, FCER1G, LST1, HLA-DRA, and ITGAM; optionally split dendritic cells into cDC1/cDC2/pDC if additional dimensions are acceptable.

out_of_scope: The inclusion of rare endocrine epsilon cells, mesothelial cells, adipocytes, cycling cells, interferon response, and secretory/ER load is defensible for an all-cell human pancreas embedding and does not require deletion.
